import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    K=p[1]+p[2]*np.sin(p[9]*t)+p[3]*np.cos(p[9]*t)
    return p[0]*P*np.log(np.abs(K)/P) + p[4]*P + p[5]*P*np.log(P) + p[6]*P**2 + p[7]*np.sin(p[9]*t)*P + p[8]*np.cos(p[9]*t)*P
